This Kaycha Labs Certification shall not be reproduced, unless in its entirety, without written approval from Kaycha Labs.
The results relate only to the material or product analyzed. ND=Not Detected, ppm=Parts Per Million, ppb=Parts Per Billion,
RSD=Relative Standard Deviation. Limit of Detection (LOD) and Limit Of Quantitation (LOQ) are terms used to describe the
smallest concentration that can be detected and reliably measured by an analytical procedure, respectively. Analytical
values detected between the Limit of Detection (LOD) and the Limit of Quantitation (LOQ) are reported with a "J" qualifier.
Action Levels are State determined thresholds based on F.S. Rule 64-4.308 and F.S. Rule 5K-4. The Measurement of
Uncertainty (MU) error is available from the lab upon request. The "Decision Rule" for pass/fail does not include the MU. Any
calculated totals may contain rounding errors.
